subject: Ex-Woven
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

We've recently started working with Woven & noticed that you used to work there, so thought it could be interesting to explore if we can help at Oxa in a similar way.

Woven's Vision team faced challenges with existing data curation & visualisation solutions (Voxel51 & internal tools), which lacked the speed & scalability required to efficiently search through their training datasets (capping out at ~1m images).

At Encord, we've built a high-performance architecture to support indexing and searching through billions of data items (using embeddings visualisations, quality metric filters & natural language searches), enabling AV teams to avoid bottlenecks in model development.

Could be good for us to chat / introduce ourselves & swap notes on what we're seeing in the space. 

Would you be open to having a quick coffee chat later this week?
